items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I was in Hot Springs and talking to a fella... He was one. He was a typical brickhead. I didn't want to tell him he was one.

ctx.x: Yeah. A fella that's real bright and he's got red hair. Red looking, bad hair. Yeah. A Marani, uh, what, Marani? What are they called, the Maronis too? Did you ever hear of that?

Marani. Marani, I'm okay. Marani, brickhead, that's what it is. Marani? Marani brickhead. I was in Hot Springs and talking to a fella. He said, you from New Orleans? And I said, yeah. I said, what they call a brickhead? I said, well, pal, I really don't know. He was one. He was a typical brickhead. I didn't want to tell him he was one. You know, Marani brickhead. Because both of us was there taking his batch, you know? He was taking them and I was taking them. And I said, well, I really don't know what a…
Like Fan Tan? Yeah, like a Chinaman. You know, a fan. You know, them Chinamans like fans, you know?
